icon:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent game inventory icon for an ICON card selection voucher.
Primary request: Create one premium collectible card selection ticket, a tangible dark navy metal credential with precisely engraved platinum and restrained pale lime-gold trim. Three overlapping collectible card silhouettes form the central embossed crest; one card is lifted forward with a small luminous selection star. Distinct clipped ticket corners and finely machined surface, elegant high-rarity Korean collectible RPG item, visually readable at 64px.
Composition: one isolated object, three-quarter shallow perspective, centered, nearly fills a square canvas with 10 percent clear safe margins. No human face or character. Soft contained rim lighting, crisp contours and material depth. Match a dark navy / ivory / pale lime game inventory, avoid rainbow neon.
Text: none; no letters, numbers, logos, watermark or UI labels.
Background: genuine transparent alpha, no background rectangle, no drop shadow outside the object. Deliver a single finished item icon.
panel:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: production 9-slice UI frame texture for an ICON card selection voucher in a collectible RPG inventory.
Primary request: a single flat front-facing horizontal rectangular interface panel, approximately 3:2 aspect, dark navy enamel and brushed gunmetal, thin warm platinum-gold trim, small restrained pale lime-gold highlights on the corners, finely engraved card-selection star at the four corner clasps only. Fine premium material craftsmanship consistent with a high-rarity dark navy and gold voucher. Crisp discreet silhouette; not a parchment scroll, not a giant ornate fantasy gate.
Composition: panel square to camera, straight parallel edges, symmetrically bounded. Keep the edge region very narrow, at most 5% thickness. Huge blank center of uninterrupted near-black navy enamel with extremely subtle surface grain, uniformly dark for DOM text. No figures, objects, card shapes, text, symbols or glowing lines in the central 90%. No title plaque.
Background: actual transparent alpha outside the rectangular panel; panel center opaque dark navy. All four corners fully visible with a tiny transparent safety margin.
Constraints: image is an actual blank UI resource, no screenshot, no sample text, no surrounding mockup, no drop shadow, no perspective, no repeated panels.
